name: Sailabala Mahapatra / ଶୈଳବାଳା ମହାପାତ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sailabala Mahapatra is an Odia poet, translator and writer for children, associated with Puri. In a 2021 interview, she recalled publishing her first poem in 1976 and described translation as a creative art that connects people. Her books include the Odia poetry collection Adha Adha Swapna Jete and The Beating Treat, an English retelling of folktales from Odisha.

Her poem “ପହଂଚି ନଥିବା ଚିଠି” follows the longing for a letter through a lifetime. Childhood learning, the heat of the road, family obligations and an approaching evening become stations along that journey. The familiar post office remains a place of expectation, while the final letter has still not arrived.
